name: Home Screen Manager
description: TEST BUILD — Designs, orders, and renders hybrid Jellyfin/Abyss home sections using manual media, collections, metadata tags, and libraries.
overview: TEST BUILD — Home Screen Manager creation, ordering, rendering, and Abyss customization for Jellyfin 10.11.11.

versions.changelog: Gives every visible page its own section-loading lane so hidden Home work cannot block custom or native pages; removes duplicate Media Bar row requests; makes Top recovery lighter; preserves refreshed editor settings immediately; restores secondary-line marquees; opens Top Row editing while catalogs load; clarifies native Jellyfin maximums; and raises detail artwork slightly.
